title: SpeechT-RAG: Reliable Depression Detection in LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation Using Speech Timing Information

title: Eeyore: Realistic Depression Simulation via Expert-in-the-Loop Supervised and Preference Optimization

Sources include RED, HOPE, ESC and AnnoMI, and emotional-distress inclusion does not imply every original speaker had a verified clinical diagnosis. Results evaluate a simulator rather than treatment efficacy, and the paper reports hallucination/educational-error risks and limited expert sample size. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is still unresolved.

title: NarGINA: Towards Accurate and Interpretable Children’s Narrative Ability Assessment via Narrative Graphs
pending_reason: NarGINA is a clinical-linguistic narrative-ability assessment candidate. Physical pages3–4 describe real children aged3–13 narrating a wordless picture book under clinical-linguistics guidance, expert scoring by clinicians/educators, and gold-standard narrative graphs; page6 evaluates the resulting Chinese narrative-assessment corpus. Its actual outputs are narrative ability scores and interpretable completeness/coherence traits, not validated disease diagnoses. The task is specifically motivated and designed for language-disorder assessment/intervention, rather than general essay scoring; retain as a medical-adjacent clinical-language candidate with this limitation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: The Effectiveness of Uncased Tokeniziaion for Clinical Notes
pending_reason: The actual research primarily examines clinical-note tokenization. Sections3–5 physical pages2–4 train cased/uncased/independent-case BERT variants on MIMIC-III and evaluate MedNLI plus i2b2 clinical de-identification and concept extraction. C4/MNLI are generic comparison controls; clinical notes and clinical NLP tasks are the main subject. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Generalizable Cross-Lingual Cognitive Distortion Detection with Standardized Annotations and Multi-Task Learning
pending_reason: Primary mental-health NLP research on cognitive distortion recognition grounded in Burns’ psychological theory. Physical pages 2–4 and 9 establish cross-language/cross-dataset detection on Chinese social-media and English reframing/therapist datasets, psychology-trained annotation and a 5702-sample harmonized dataset. The authors explicitly state research use rather than clinical diagnosis and acknowledge privacy, re-identification and cultural-generalization risks. This is a targeted mental-health research objective, not a generic model with incidental medical evaluation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Can Medical Vision-Language Pre-training Succeed with Purely Synthetic Data?
pending_reason: This is medical vision-language pretraining with purely synthetic chest X-rays and radiology reports. Physical pages5–6 describe 200000 SynCXR image-report pairs,ConVIRT/GLoRIA medical contrastive models,and disease classification,visual grounding and segmentation experiments. RSNA,SIIM and Covid-19Rural grounding are explicitly evaluated. The actual study is biomedical throughout. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Argus: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for 3D Radiology Report Generation
pending_reason: Argus targets 3D radiology report generation. Physical page3 constructs CT-3DRRG from BIMCV-R,CT-RATE and INSPECT CT/report resources;physical page6 compares training schedules and 3DRRG baselines on this medical dataset. This is a medical-primary study,including clinical image resolution and diagnostic-detail preservation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: ASTRID - An Automated and Scalable TRIaD for the Evaluation of RAG-based Clinical Question Answering Systems
pending_reason: ASTRID evaluates clinical RAG QA for cataract-surgery follow-up. Physical pages6–7 describe 102 unique questions collected through interactions with120 consenting patients at two UK hospitals,206 conversational triplets before balancing,and clinician-augmented out-of-scope examples. ClinicalQAC includes132 examples rated by ophthalmic surgeons for harm,helpfulness and appropriateness. The study is medical-primary. The abstract wording200+patient questions must not be confused with the body102unique questions/206triplets. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: The Anatomy of Evidence: An Investigation Into Explainable ICD Coding
pending_reason: Primary clinical NLP study of explainable ICD coding. Pages 2, 5, 8 and 9 analyze MDACE/MIMIC-III clinical-record evidence, compare supervised/unsupervised code explanations and introduce proximity-aware evidence match measures for medical coders. The central objective and all substantive evaluations concern clinical coding evidence, with explicit limitations about annotation, limited discharge-summary data, false positives, over-trust and lack of causal interpretation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: EMRs2CSP : Mining Clinical Status Pathway from Electronic Medical Records
pending_reason: EMRs2CSP extracts clinical status pathways from electronic medical records. Physical pages5–6 specify400expert-reviewed breast-cancer records from a tertiary hospital,1127Huatuo breast-cancer QA examples,and evaluation of extraction,medicalQA and treatment-process decision support. The actual task and experiments are medical-primary;automatic metrics and LLM judgments do not establish clinical efficacy. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Libra: Leveraging Temporal Images for Biomedical Radiology Analysis
pending_reason: Libra generates radiology Findings from temporal chest X-rays. Physical pages5–6 specify MIMIC-CXR,Medical-Diff-VQA and MIMIC-Ext-MIMIC-CXR-VQA,frontal current/prior images,and radiology-specific evaluation. The study is medical imaging/report generation throughout. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: AskQE: Question Answering as Automatic Evaluation for Machine Translation
pending_reason: AskQE is a general translation-quality framework whose actual study is biomedical-primary. Physical pages4–5 construct ContraTICO from COVID19 TICO-19 translations and evaluate BioMQM biomedical translation errors;footnote8 explicitly excludes general MT benchmarks to focus on high-stakes contexts,and language pairs are chosen for healthcare demand. Physical page8 compares error-severity judgments and accept/reject simulations on BioMQM. Inclusion is grounded in primary actual experiments,not an incidental medical example;the simulation is not a deployment validation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: JEBS: A Fine-grained Biomedical Lexical Simplification Task
pending_reason: JEBS defines and evaluates biomedical lexical simplification, not general text simplification with a medical side test. Pages 2–4, 6 and 8 specify 400 PubMed abstracts from PLABA, 10,314 expert terms and 21,595 typed simplifications; identification, classification and generation are all biomedical tasks. Expert human ratings concern simplicity, accuracy, completeness and brevity, not demonstrated patient outcomes. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Look & Mark: Leveraging Radiologist Eye Fixations and Bounding boxes in Multimodal Large Language Models for Chest X-ray Report Generation
pending_reason: Look & Mark is primarily chest-X-ray radiology report generation. Pages 2–4 and 6–7 combine expert eye fixations and abnormality boxes using REFLACX/MS_CXR from MIMIC-CXR, with 560 images and 1,372 dictated reports; the research and evaluation center on clinically grounded report quality. Gains vary by model, so this is not uniform benefit or proven clinical deployment. Figure 1 explicitly substitutes a Wikimedia radiograph and paraphrases the report, rather than reproducing a MIMIC image. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Sign2Vis: Automated Data Visualization from Sign Language
pending_reason: SIGN2VIS is explicitly disability-specific assistive accessibility for Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing users, rather than generic sign-language modeling with incidental health motivation. Pages 2, 8, 15–16 and 18 describe a sign-language visualization interface and a study of 15 DHH community participants. Crucial limitation: participants watched prerecorded translated task demonstrations and gave feedback; they did not directly operate the system, and the local sign-language dialect differs from ASL. Retain as a disability-accessibility candidate, without treatment or real-use efficacy claims; central scope review agrees. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: MedCite: Can Language Models Generate Verifiable Text for Medicine?
pending_reason: MedCite is biomedical-primary citation generation and evaluation. Physical pages3–4 define biomedical QA on BioASQ-Y/N and PubMedQA using24.6million PubMed documents;pages8–9 evaluate citation precision/recall and agreement with professional medical-doctor attribution judgments. Benchmark attribution reliability is not evidence of patient-outcome or clinical deployment effectiveness. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Systematic Evaluation of Auto-Encoding and Large Language Model Representations for Capturing Author States and Traits
pending_reason: The actual study is longitudinal health-related psychological measurement in120service-industry workers selected for elevated alcohol-use risk. Physical pages2–3 document10,108ecological momentary assessments over two years,PHQ9/GAD7/PSS mental-health measures,AUDIT-C/drinks/craving and affect. Pages6–7 evaluate these outcomes across temporal levels alongside personality and sociodemographic secondary dimensions. Include as mental-health/substance-use language measurement,while preserving the broader psychological scope and self-reported outcomes;no clinical diagnosis or intervention validation is established. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Worse than Random? An Embarrassingly Simple Probing Evaluation of Large Multimodal Models in Medical VQA
pending_reason: ProbMed is explicitly a medical visual-question-answering and diagnostic-reliability benchmark. Pages 4–6 establish 6,303 images from MedICaT and ChestX-ray14, 57,132 QA pairs, paired adversarial questions, modality/organ/abnormality/condition/location evaluation and twelve medical/general models tested on those medical tasks. Two experts verify only a sampled 100 metadata entries and 1,090 QA pairs; this is benchmark evaluation, not demonstrated clinical deployment or patient benefit. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: ProMind-LLM: Proactive Mental Health Care via Causal Reasoning with Sensor Data
pending_reason: ProMind-LLM directly targets weekly mental-health-risk classification from wearable/behavioral data and self-reported mental records. Pages 5–6 establish PMData (16 people, five months) and Globem (497 participants over four years, with 25% sampled for testing). Risk labels are newly annotated with licensed psychological-expert review, not pre-existing clinical diagnoses. Page 9 explicitly limits real-world, uncontrolled-population validity. This is medical-primary mental-health research; causal prompting is not established clinical causality or treatment benefit. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: EMGLLM: Data-to-Text Alignment for Electromyogram Diagnosis Generation with Medical Numerical Data Encoding
pending_reason: EMGLLM is medical-primary data-to-text diagnosis generation fromelectromyography/nerve-conduction tables. Physical page5 specifies17,250anonymized realHuashanHospital/Fudan reports from2006–2013 withphysicianFindings/Impression and13800/1725/1725splits;page6 definesmedical reference-value encoding andbaselines;page7 reportsautomated,GPT4o and50casehuman evaluation. Retrospective report-generation scores do not establish prospective clinical efficacy or autonomous diagnostic safety. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Exploring the Role of Mental Health Conversational Agents in Training Medical Students and Professionals: A Systematic Literature Review
pending_reason: Medical education is the specific research subject: a PRISMA-style systematic review of conversational agents for mental-health education/training of medical students and professionals, reporting 38 selected studies from 1003 records in 2019–2024. §3.3 explicitly targets healthcare learners and excludes patient-treatment-only, general-healthcare/no-mental-health, conceptual and non-peer-reviewed work. The results synthesize technical systems, training applications, datasets and clinical/technical evaluation; not a new patient trial or demonstrated clinical benefit. Preserve internal reporting caveats: §3.2 says 217 full-text records while §3.4 says an initial 216-paper subset; several technology/data counts and percentages imply denominator37 despite the stated38 studies. Formal Long/Short remains unverified. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Natural Language Processing in Support of Evidence-based Medicine: A Scoping Review
pending_reason: Primary evidence-based medicine scoping review of129 studies: §2 requires NLP applications specifically for EBM in humans, with independently cross-verified selection; §3 maps Ask/Acquire/Appraise/Apply/Assess to NLP tasks. The synthesis centers biomedical evidence retrieval, extraction, appraisal, clinical-trial use and clinical workflow. General-text benchmark limitations are discussed within this explicitly medical research question, not a generic cross-domain demonstration. A review, not a new clinical efficacy trial. Formal Long/Short unverified. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Does Rationale Quality Matter? Enhancing Mental Disorder Detection via Selective Reasoning Distillation
pending_reason: Mental-health detection is the specific main research and experiment: selective rationale distillation for Reddit_depression binary labels (17678/2696/2696 train/validation/test), with DSM-5-related relevance scoring and two psychology-domain experts evaluating270 explanations. Appendix G adds Depression Reddit, Dreaddit stress and Reddit_anxiety, remaining mental-health-specific. These social-media labels and generated explanations are not confirmed psychiatric diagnoses; the authors explicitly caution against diagnostic use and request real-world clinical evaluation. Ethics states paper examples are paraphrased and data releases exclude original dataset content. Formal Long/Short unverified. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: CliniDial: A Naturally Occurring Multimodal Dialogue Dataset for Team Reflection in Action During Clinical Operation
pending_reason: CliniDial is medical-primary teamwork analysis during simulated clinical operations. Physical pages 2–4 describe 22 malignant-hyperthermia surgical simulation sessions, six participants/session, 6.5k turns, 49.9k words, two camera angles and nine simulated physiological signals, with Seek/Evaluate/Plan/Implement labels and 17/2/3-session ten-fold classification splits. Page 9 reports best macro F1 51.09 and explicitly warns that simulated operations lack real clinical urgency; audio was collected but not evaluated here. These are mannequin scenarios, not patient outcome or real-operative safety validation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: SignMusketeers: An Efficient Multi-Stream Approach for Sign Language Translation at Scale
pending_reason: Specific Deaf/hard-of-hearing communication accessibility task: p1 explicitly identifies ASL-to-written-language translation to bridge DHH/hearing communication; p7 experiments exclusively use YouTube-ASL and How2Sign, learning face/hand/body linguistic representations. Retained as dedicated disability-assistance research under the established accessibility scope, not because any video contains human faces. It is offline ASL-English translation/compute evaluation; p9 says accuracy remains inadequate to replace interpreters, and no clinical benefit is demonstrated. Formal Long/Short pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: MEDEC: A Benchmark for Medical Error Detection and Correction in Clinical Notes
pending_reason: MEDEC is directly clinical:3848 texts, five medical-error classes, three error-detection/localization/correction tasks and comparisons with medical doctors. MS3360 is constructed from medical board-exam scenarios; UW488 is sampled from real notes across three UW hospital systems with manually injected errors and de-identification. Doctors annotated569 of925 test notes with242 overlap. UW data require a DUA; the paper explicitly limits its intended use to research, not diagnosis/treatment. Formal Long/Short pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Evaluation of LLMs in Medical Text Summarization: The Role of Vocabulary Adaptation in High OOV Settings
pending_reason: The study is biomedical-primary vocabulary adaptation for query-focused medical summarization. Physical pages 4–6 use BioASQ-9B, EBM and PubMedQA, plus 20K PubMed Abstract Collection documents for continual pretraining; evaluation separates high medical OOV concentration and novelty and compares ROUGE-L/UMLS concepts. Page 8 reports a 30-example medical-expert evaluation with three annotators per summary pair. Results support retrospective summarization quality, not prospective clinical safety or patient benefit. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Predicting Depression in Screening Interviews from Interactive Multi-Theme Collaboration
pending_reason: Primary depression screening from clinical-interview text on DAIC-WOZ. The model extracts five themes, learns within/across-theme relationships and weights them using LLM-simulated clinician feedback. The entire main experiment and analysis concern depression classification. p9 explicitly states that simulated feedback reliability needs evaluation and real-world clinical validation is absent; the authors diagnostic wording is not treated as proof of clinical deployment. Formal type pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: AnnaAgent: Dynamic Evolution Agent System with Multi-Session Memory for Realistic Seeker Simulation
pending_reason: Dedicated mental-health counseling seeker simulation with dynamic emotion/chief-complaint evolution and multi-session memory. D4 and DAIC-WOZ counseling records seed prior sessions; mental-health counselor models interact with simulated seekers, evaluated against real-seeker text and persona/memory consistency. Privacy agreements and conditional release are explicit; this is supplementary simulation, not proof of therapeutic benefit or a valid substitute for real patients. Formal type pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: KaFT: Knowledge-aware Fine-tuning for Boosting LLMs’ Domain-specific Question-Answering Performance
pending_reason: Medical QA is the main actual experimental direction of this otherwise general knowledge-conflict fine-tuning method. Sections2.3/4.1 train on MedQA; Table2 and ablations analyze English/Chinese medical exams, and multilingual medical transfer is substantive. History/engineering/law serve OOD tests and later extensions; generic HaluEval is also reported. The paper explicitly frames those as generalization/additional applications (p8), and its conclusion returns to medical QA. Retain biomedical-main-experiments candidate, not inferred from dataset counts. Benchmark accuracy is not clinical validation. Formal Long/Short pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Automated main concept generation for narrative discourse assessment in aphasia
pending_reason: Medical-primary aphasia assessment support: physical pages 4–6 define main-concept generation following speech/language-disorder assessment literature and evaluate clinically curated BATS story concepts validated using aphasic/non-aphasic retells. NARRASUM movie/TV summaries provide supplemental intrinsic validity because BATS is small. Page 8 reports BATS recall/yield trade-offs. This generates editable assessment resources for clinicians, not autonomous diagnosis or patient-outcome validation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: MAGI: Multi-Agent Guided Interview for Psychiatric Assessment
pending_reason: Dedicated psychiatric assessment via MINI-based multi-agent interviewing and DSM-5-aligned PsyCoT. Main experiments address depression, generalized/social anxiety and suicide-risk expert agreement, not incidental medical prompts. Authors describe1002 university mental-health interview sessions with two licensed expert annotators; dialogue-quality comparisons additionally use LLM-simulated participants, which must remain distinct. Page9 reports informed consent and non-diagnostic research boundaries, no AI analyses directly shared with participants, and clinical diagnoses reserved for psychiatrists. No treatment efficacy or deployment safety is established here. Formal Long/Short remains pending; complete profile independently assigned. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: A Fully Generative Motivational Interviewing Counsellor Chatbot for Moving Smokers Towards the Decision to Quit
pending_reason: Medical-primary smoking cessation counselling: physical pages 5–7 and 9–10 describe GPT-4o MIBot and AutoMISC in a feasibility study of 106 adult smokers recruited through Prolific. Self-reported confidence increased 1.7/10 at one week; readiness change was not significant. This was not a randomized controlled trial and historical human-counsellor comparisons are not matched experimental controls. The authors explicitly do not claim fully effective therapy. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: From Conversation to Automation: Leveraging LLMs for Problem-Solving Therapy Analysis
pending_reason: Medical-primary analysis of Problem-Solving Therapy: physical pages 3–5 and 8–9 use 240 PISCES sessions involving 152 hospice family caregivers, with 500 manually annotated utterances and 5000 GPT-labelled training examples. GPT-4o annotates PST strategies and therapeutic dynamics; ModernBERT is distilled from pseudo-labels. The abstracts call .76 accuracy, whereas Table1 and conclusion identify weighted F1 .76. This is therapy-session annotation and discourse analysis, not validated treatment efficacy; English transcripts omit tone and nonverbal cues. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: MAM: Modular Multi-Agent Framework for Multi-Modal Medical Diagnosis via Role-Specialized Collaboration
pending_reason: Medical-primary MAM multi-agent diagnosis framework: physical pages 4 and 6–8 define general practitioner, specialists, radiologist, assistant and director agents, and evaluate ten medical text/image/audio/video datasets (MedQA, PubMedQA, PathVQA, PMC-VQA, DeepLesion, NIH chest X-rays, brain tumour, Heartbeat, SoundDr and adapted MedVidQA). Results and ablations are benchmark accuracy, not a clinical deployment or patient-outcome validation. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: DiaLLMs: EHR-Enhanced Clinical Conversational System for Clinical Test Recommendation and Diagnosis Prediction
pending_reason: DiaLLM is a dedicated EHR-grounded clinical dialogue/test-recommendation/diagnosis system. Actual experiments use NHANES diabetes8897patients and TriNetX33105de-identified patients for metabolic, respiratory and circulatory disease prediction. EHR-to-dialogue conversion and clinical-test reference/interpretation are central, with retrospective single/multi-turn prediction and expert input. Page9 explicitly says real-world clinical reliability is not established and requires clinician oversight/validation. Formal Long/Short pending; no treatment-effect inference. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Enhancing Medical Dialogue Generation through Knowledge Refinement and Dynamic Prompt Adjustment
pending_reason: MedRef specifically generates medical doctor responses through medical-knowledge refinement and dynamically selected triplets/demonstrations. Main MedDG/KaMed experiments measure response similarity, medical-entity F1 and human fluency/knowledge/quality ratings. This is dedicated healthcare dialogue research, while benchmark scores and illustrative cases do not establish patient benefit or real-world reliability. Authors position it as assistive and require qualified-provider consultation. Formal Long/Short pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Just Put a Human in the Loop? Investigating LLM-Assisted Annotation for Subjective Tasks
pending_reason: Boundary candidate included on actual public-health experimental primacy despite a general annotation-method title. Physical pages 3–4 explicitly designate 200 NYC health-resource/vaccine-decision interview excerpts as the main dataset, tested with a control, all three GPT assistance conditions and a Llama replication. Boston housing/safety/political conversations are only a partial Condition1 replication. Pages 6–9 report main NYC label-overlap/performance experiments; Table2 on page8 covers 20 health/vaccine labels, and discussion directly shows changes in inferred vaccine motivations and Health Education/Support. Retain the broader computational-social-science purpose and nonmedical replication; this does not measure clinical outcomes. Sent for independent central scope adjudication. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: Can You Share Your Story? Modeling Clients’ Metacognition and Openness for LLM Therapist Evaluation
pending_reason: Medical-primary psychological-counselling evaluation: physical pages 3,5,6,8 describe MindVoyager using expert CBT cognitive diagrams from Patient-psi-CM, dynamically masking/unmasking client beliefs according to openness and metacognition. Experiments compare LLM therapists with cognitive-diagram exposure and induced-similarity metrics, not actual patient benefit. Final PDF expressly disclaims advocating LLM counselling. It is simulator-based mental-health-system assessment, not validated treatment. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: IntentionESC: An Intention-Centered Framework for Enhancing Emotional Support in Dialogue Systems
pending_reason: IntentionESC specifically models emotional support using therapist intentions adapted from Helping Skills counseling theory, linking emotional states, intentions and support strategies. Main ESConv experiments evaluate support responses and empathic/helpfulness dimensions, so it is a dedicated mental-health-support candidate. ESConv1300 dialogues and human/GPT4 evaluations, including GPT4-simulated seekers, do not establish clinical efficacy. Whole-conversation agreement is low (reported kappa .12/.17/.26/.27); no patient-outcome claim. Formal Long/Short pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.

title: CSTRL: Context-Driven Sequential Transfer Learning for Abstractive Radiology Report Summarization
pending_reason: CSTRL is dedicated radiology Findings-to-Impression summarization using gap-sentence pretraining, Fisher-guided sequential learning and distillation. Main experiments use MIMIC-CXR/OpenI report text, factuality/text metrics and fifty reports rated by three radiology researchers plus two clinical radiologists. This is actual clinical documentation research; benchmark and small expert evaluation do not establish deployment safety or patient benefit. Formal Long/Short pending. Explicit formal Long/Short evidence is unresolved.
